corrections: REVENUE/ORGANIC understated in the debate: bull/dossier cite FY2025 revenue EUR3.67B and organic +1.1% (these are the FMP adjusted-revenue figures). JCDecaux's reported FY2025 revenue is EUR3,967.1M with organic growth +1.8% (+3.2% ex-2024 Olympics/Euro). The deceleration narrative still holds directionally (off the +13.4% 2024 boom) but both the base and the organic rate were understated; the correction is mildly bull-favorable.

OPERATING MARGIN is a non-IFRS subtotal, not EBIT: the EUR831.1M 'Operating Margin' is JCDecaux's own reported profitability line (revenue less direct opex/SG&A before D&A of rights), NOT operating income (FMP EBIT FY2025 = EUR446.5M). The SoP applies multiples to segment-level Operating Margin, which is JCDecaux's standard segment metric and internally consistent — but the label should read 'Operating Margin (company-defined)', not 'EBIT', to avoid double-counting concession amortization.

Q2-2026 ~+3% guidance is NOT in the FY2025 release (which guided 'above +5% organic in Q1-2026'); it is sourced from the later Q1-2026 release. Not contradicted, just attributed to the wrong document in the dossier.
